How many chat tickets were created today?

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT TICKET_ID) AS ticket_count
FROM DBT_PRODUCTION.FCT_ZENDESK__MQR_TICKETS
WHERE STATUS IN ('closed', 'solved')
    AND (ASSIGNEE_NAME != 'Automated Update' OR ASSIGNEE_NAME IS NULL)
    AND (ASSIGNEE_NAME != 'TechOps Bot' OR ASSIGNEE_NAME IS NULL)
    AND (NOT LOWER(TICKET_TAGS) LIKE '%email_blocked%' OR TICKET_TAGS IS NULL)
    AND (NOT LOWER(TICKET_TAGS) LIKE '%bulk_email_tool%' OR TICKET_TAGS IS NULL)
    AND (NOT LOWER(TICKET_TAGS) LIKE '%seattle_psst_monthly_email%' OR TICKET_TAGS IS NULL)
    AND CHANNEL IN ('api', 'email', 'native_messaging', 'web')
    AND BRAND_ID IN ('29186504989207', '360002340693')
    AND GROUP_ID = '17837476387479'
    AND TO_DATE(TO_TIMESTAMP_LTZ(CREATED_AT_PST)) = CURRENT_DATE()

Show me agents in the bottom 10% for QA score this week

WITH qa_percentiles AS (
    SELECT 
        ASSIGNEE_NAME,
        QA_SCORE,
        PERCENTILE_CONT(0.1) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY QA_SCORE) OVER () AS bottom_10_percentile
    FROM ANALYTICS.DBT_PRODUCTION.RPT_WOPS_AGENT_PERFORMANCE
    WHERE QA_SCORE IS NOT NULL
        AND SOLVED_WEEK = DATE_TRUNC('week', CURRENT_DATE())
)
SELECT 
    ASSIGNEE_NAME,
    QA_SCORE,
    bottom_10_percentile
FROM qa_percentiles
WHERE QA_SCORE <= bottom_10_percentile
ORDER BY QA_SCORE ASC

SELECT

    AVG(CASE WHEN sa.ADHERENCE_PERCENTAGE = '-' THEN NULL

    AND sa.ADHERENCE_DATE >= DATE_TRUNC('week', CURRENT_DATE()) - INTERVAL '1 week'
    AND sa.ADHERENCE_DATE < DATE_TRUNC('week', CURRENT_DATE())
    AND p.SOLVED_WEEK = DATE_TRUNC('week', CURRENT_DATE()) - INTERVAL '1 week'
GROUP BY sa.AGENT_NAME
ORDER BY avg_adherence DESC

What are our average response times this week?

SELECT 
  AVG(REPLY_TIME_IN_MINUTES) as avg_response_time,
  AVG(FIRST_RESOLUTION_TIME_IN_MINUTES) as avg_resolution_time,
  COUNT(*) as total_tickets
FROM ANALYTICS.DBT_PRODUCTION.RPT_WOPS_TICKETS
WHERE CREATED_AT_PST >= DATE_TRUNC('week', DATE(CONVERT_TIMEZONE('UTC', 'America/Los_Angeles', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())))
Show me response time distribution this week

SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN REPLY_TIME_IN_MINUTES <= 15 THEN '0-15 min (Excellent)'
    WHEN REPLY_TIME_IN_MINUTES <= 60 THEN '15-60 min (Good)'
    WHEN REPLY_TIME_IN_MINUTES <= 240 THEN '1-4 hours'
    ELSE '4+ hours (Critical)'
  END as response_time_bucket,
  COUNT(*) as ticket_count
FROM ANALYTICS.DBT_PRODUCTION.RPT_WOPS_TICKETS
WHERE CREATED_AT_PST >= DATE_TRUNC('week', DATE(CONVERT_TIMEZONE('UTC', 'America/Los_Angeles', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())))
GROUP BY response_time_bucket
ORDER BY MIN(REPLY_TIME_IN_MINUTES)
